notes.title: Update 20.0
notes.content:
1 - Game saving and loading are now available[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/7c4604891a431e063de39c6720ea39ed03b54344.png[/img]

2 - Mega ships have been rebalanced. Updated the science system for researching mega ships (each ship now has its own dedicated science branch)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/68db1337ba68cd4f2d05ecf913349d0fb8e302f2.png[/img]

3 - Pilots (regardless of type—fearless, standard, or coward) will now repair their ships to 90%+ health before heading out on adventures
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/2e341015440c32c035ff470dea0ed0c6911be32d.png[/img]

4 - Added an extensive text-based tutorial
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/83ae3e3d040e81d1bff984039cced943d8133b37.png[/img]

5 - Fixed several UI bugs related to starting new missions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/2de9b64ccf48b440b332799a6c797581617e6b39.png[/img]

6 - Slightly rebalanced some missions and fixed bugs in certain missions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/516607cfbf6f6bc2b49296c1d8a564ede3f3b368.png[/img]

7 - The invisibility item has been replaced with a temporary (1.5 sec) invulnerability item
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/363633c37c1a661186541c88e3d43831e111269b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/751464f6235d6fd581f2509bd6c0e73e8b5981fb.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 19.8
notes.content:
Interface fixes:
Improved tooltips
Improved science window
Added Esc handling

Tutorial:
Skipping a task counts as completing it
Now you can turn on the tutorial video at any time

notes.title: Upgrade 19.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/bd128b733533370322e5a47b789bb935d10d1f14.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A pilot-followers will never join a inland pilots. (This should make the situation where everyone sits at home much more rare)
[*] Improved tutorial interface for many resolutions
[*] Asteroids no longer damage buildings
[*] Fixed a bug where a mine was running out of ore.
[*] Improved settings menu
[*] Fixed some bugs (maybe not all of them yet) that could lead to inability to control.
[/list]

notes.title: Upgrade 19.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/172c26585d2f043185ee9636604dafa0e37fcbc4.png[/img]
[list]

If you have found a critical bug - please send logs to Kinderril@gmail.com or discord.

notes.title: Update 018.2
notes.content:
Redesigned visuals of all player stations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/555cd1c0ef5f186e3c3aa06079678b7d1ecd0ec2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/c662348854d2effb201e783c3575176d9dc7a56e.png[/img]
Added a new special ability: “to target” when used moves the ship closer to its destination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/3d2c8d5f72ac360eb29cc927abf045fbd3dda336.png[/img]
Redesigned station connection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/186cbab4e2079f80049f27bc640ac0212564f4f6.png[/img]
Prepared a few more missions for the release version of the game.
